digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess runtime scoping
propositions: Write and apply paths currently rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of using operation-scoped runtimes established in S2, creating credential leakage risk across unrelated sibling processes

Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in four locations: write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default, causing unintended scope writes when not explicitly configured
Child processes receive full parent environment overlay and shared Rebar adapter secrets instead of isolated environments with only their owning adapter material and unknown native SDK variables
Four implicit DIG defaults must be eliminated so no request uses DIG unless explicitly configured: resolve_jira_settings, access_check probe, runtime constant, and project_ensures constant
Missing or revoked cloud write scope must fail closed with typed pre-mutation errors before any provider request, with zero requests targeting DIG when write scope is absent
